I welcome enquiries from researchers, clinicians, and members of the public. Please see below for how to get in touch.

**Email** [valeska.kozik\@med.uni-jena.de](mailto:valeska.kozik@med.uni-jena.de)

**Address** Universitätsklinikum Jena, Klinik für Neurologie, Am Klinikum 1, 07747 Jena, Germany

 

**Types of enquiries welcome:**

-   *Study participation* — if you are interested in taking part in one of the research studies, please visit the [Participate / Teilnahme](participate.qmd) page for more information.
-   *Professional collaboration* — I am happy to hear from researchers and clinicians interested in collaborative projects.
-   *Questions about my research* — if you have read about one of my studies and would like to know more, please don't hesitate to get in touch.

**Wilkommene Anfragen:**
